palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward, ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization.

Here's an example of a very long palindrome:

"Amore Roma, la marina, e il mare, è l'amore."

This Italian phrase translates to "Love Rome, the sea, and the sea, it is love." If you remove all non-alphabetical characters and spaces, then this becomes a 255-character-long palindrome.
